```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

orig_render_figure_template <- render_figure_template
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {
    options$max_height <- "0.42\\textheight"
  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}
```

```{r load-gazetteer, include=FALSE}
gaz <- jsonlite::fromJSON("circassia_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

fmt_pop <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_yr <- function(y) {
  yi <- as.integer(y)
  if (yi < 0) paste0(abs(yi), "BC") else paste0(yi, "AD")
}

get_span <- function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return("-")
  if (min(yrs) == max(yrs)) return(fmt_yr(min(yrs)))
  paste0(fmt_yr(min(yrs)), " - ", fmt_yr(max(yrs)))
}

get_pop_yr <- function(s, yr) {
  k <- as.character(as.integer(yr))
  if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  return("-")
}

get_pop_window <- function(s, yr_vec) {
  for (y in yr_vec) {
    k <- as.character(as.integer(y))
    if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  }
  return("-")
}

get_peak_str <- function(s) {
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(s$population))
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  idx <- which.max(vals)
  paste0(fmt_pop(vals[idx]), " (", fmt_yr(yrs[idx]), ")")
}
```

# Abstract

Across the 122,9k km² of historical Circassia and Central Ciscaucasia, urban and rural settlements have developed in four distinct waves from the Eneolithic to 1900AD. Fortified Eneolithic and Early Bronze Age villages at Meshoko, Svobodnoe and Galyugay, followed by Western Caucasian dolmen settlements and Koban terrace villages around Mount Elbrus and the Kislovodsk basin, preceded the classical urban network of the Asiatic Bosporus and the Kuban plain, where Phanagoria (14k at 300BC), Gorgippia (8k at 1AD), Hermonassa and the Maeotian trading town of Elizavetinskoye (5k at 300BC) anchored a dense grain-exporting countryside [@korenevskiy2004; @kuznetsov2017phanagoria; @alekseeva1997anapa].

In the Middle Ages, the largest inland centres shifted to the Christian Alanic cathedral towns and fortresses of the upper Kuban and Terek valleys - led by Nizhniy Arkhyz (8,5k in 1000AD), Khumara and the two Dzhulats (Verkhniy and Nizhniy Dzhulat) - alongside the Genoese-Zichian ports of Matrega (Taman), Copa (Slavyansk) and Mapa (Anapa) [@kuznetsov1993; @khotko2015zichia]. Following Timur's 1395 campaign, settlement dispersed into Circassian, Kabardian and Abaza lowland and foothill villages (*kabaki*) and Ossetian and Karachay-Balkar mountain stone *auls* (such as Dargavs and Kart-Dzhurt). In the late 18th and 19th centuries, the founding of Russian fortresses, the 1860-1864 *muhajir* expulsion and railway colonisation created a new urban hierarchy led by Yekaterinodar (65,6k in 1897AD), Vladikavkaz (43,7k), Yeysk (35,4k), Maykop (34,3k), Pyatigorsk (18,4k) and Novorossiysk (16,9k) [@troynitskiy1905kuban; @kabuzan1996].

# Methodology

This gazetteer gives population estimates for `r length(gaz)` towns and villages across Krasnodar Krai, Adygea, Karachay-Cherkessia, Kabardino-Balkaria, North Ossetia and the Kislovodsk basin from 10000BC to 1900AD.

Prehistoric, Greek and Alanic figures are based on the size of excavated settlements and cemeteries [@formozov1965stone; @korenevskiy2004; @markovin1978dolmens; @reinhold2017; @belinskiy2018; @kuznetsov2017phanagoria; @alekseeva1997anapa; @kuznetsov1992; @kuznetsov1993; @korobov2017]. Early modern and 19th-century estimates come from Genoese and Ottoman port records, Russian embassy reports and records of the 1859-1864 expulsions [@kusheva1963; @gardanov1967social; @volkova1974; @khotko2001; @khotko2015zichia; @berger1860expulsion; @kumykov1994], while the 1897 and 1900 figures are taken from the first Russian imperial census [@kabuzan1996; @troynitskiy1905kuban; @bgeu2007demography; @golovlev2017census].

# Results

## Settlement Directory

```{r tab-master, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_master <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(gaz, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(gaz, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(gaz, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  Span = vapply(gaz, get_span, character(1)),
  Peak = vapply(gaz, get_peak_str, character(1)),
  AD1897 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1897), character(1)),
  AD1900 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1900), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_master,
  list(
    caption = "Complete list of catalogued towns, fortresses and villages in Circassia and Central Ciscaucasia, showing alternative names, coordinates, documented dates, peak population and 1897/1900AD census figures.",
    label = "tab:circassia-master-gazetteer",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Other Names", "Coords", "Dates", "Peak Population", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

## Regional Settlement Gazetteer

### Prehistoric, Bronze Age, Bosporan and Maeotian Settlements

```{r tab-prehistoric, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
pre_s <- Filter(function(s) any(as.integer(names(s$population)) <= 400), gaz)

df_pre <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(pre_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(pre_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  BC_Eneol = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-8000, -4000, -3500, -3000)), character(1)),
  BC_Dolmen_Koban = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-2500, -2000, -1500, -1000)), character(1)),
  BC500 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, -500), character(1)),
  BC300 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, -300), character(1)),
  AD1 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1), character(1)),
  AD300_400 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(200, 300, 400)), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_pre,
  list(
    caption = "Estimated populations of Eneolithic and Maykop villages (Meshoko, Svobodnoe and Galyugay), Western Caucasian dolmen and Koban centres, and the Greek Bosporan and Maeotian towns (Phanagoria, Gorgippia, Hermonassa and Elizavetinskoye).",
    label = "tab:circassia-prehistoric-classical",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Coords", "8000-3000BC", "2500-1000BC", "500BC", "300BC", "1AD", "200-400AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

### Medieval and Early Modern Settlements

```{r tab-medieval, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
med_s <- Filter(function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 600 & yrs <= 1700)
}, gaz)

df_med <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(med_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(med_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  AD600_800 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(600, 800)), character(1)),
  AD1000 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1000), character(1)),
  AD1200 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1200), character(1)),
  AD1400 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1350, 1400)), character(1)),
  AD1600 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1600), character(1)),
  AD1700 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1700), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = "Populations of Christian Alanic cathedral towns and fortresses (Nizhniy Arkhyz, Khumara, Rim-Gora and the two Dzhulats), Genoese-Zichian trading ports (Matrega, Copa and Mapa) and early modern Circassian, Kabardian and Ossetian centres.",
    label = "tab:circassia-medieval-settlements",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Coords", "600/800AD", "1000AD", "1200AD", "1350/1400AD", "1600AD", "1700AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```
